claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: N-methylquipazine is a quipazine-derived arylpiperazine 5-HT3 agonist/SERT ligand that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cells through its annotated serotonin-receptor pharmacology; any weak, non-selective antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic/arylpiperazine off-target effect rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
